SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.P.H.S. No. REGISTRY. No. D 5642 Date 25 / 1 54）
Date January 24, 1954.

Subject (in full) Anonymous letter regarding communist suspects.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by D. I. Somerset

With reference to the attached anonymous letter alleging that three Fokienese communists named Toong Tsong Yuen(董宗元), Li(李) and Zau(趙) are residing in the Kyih Sung(結陞) Lodging House, No.10, Lane 195, Fokien Road, I have to report the following result of enquiries made into this matter by C.D.S.48:-

The lodging house in question, which consists of some thirty rooms, is occupied exclusively by merchants visiting Shanghai from Wenchow and Ningpo, and, as a rule, no rooms are let to other people.

The lodging house registration book was examined and the entries scrutinized over a period of several weeks but no names corresponding to these mentioned in the anonymous letter were found.

It is surmised that the letter was written by some person wishing to embarrass the lodging house proprietor.

（印：...）
Cef
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S.2，特别分部
报告
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 中央捕房户籍科 登记号 D 5642 日期 25 / 1 54）
日期：1954年1月24日。

主题（全称）：关于共产党嫌疑人的匿名信。

呈报人：督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） 转呈人：督察萨默塞特（Somerset）

关于所附匿名信指控三名福建籍共产党人董宗元（Toong Tsong Yuen）、李氏（Li）和赵氏（Zau）居住在福建路195弄10号结陞（Kyih Sung）客栈一事，兹报告中央捕房刑事侦缉处第48组（C.D.S.48）对此事进行调查的结果如下：

该客栈约有三十个房间，住客 exclusively 为来自温州和宁波的赴沪商人，通常不将房间出租给其他人。

经查阅该客栈的登记簿，并对数周内的记录进行了仔细审查，未发现与匿名信中提及的姓名相符者。

推测此信系某人为了陷害客栈老板而写。

（印章：...）
Cef
顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）
督察

特别分部主管警官。

Made by.........D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa................Forwarded by............................................................

I forward herewith an anonymous letter dated January 18,
1934, addressed to me c/o Police Headquarters, alleging that
certain communist suspects from Fokien are now staying in the
Kyih Sung (吉) Lodging House, House No.10, Lane 195, Fokien

The postal cancellation on the envelope shows that
the letter was posted at 1 a.m. January 19, 1934, at the
C.P.O. Head Office, North Szechuen Road.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Direct enquiries re. occupants of lodging house
Officer i/c Special Branch. are being made 22/1/34.

result of enquiries
in due course.

pages.en:
Translation of an anonymous letter dated January 18,1934,
addressed to D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa c/o Shanghai Municipal
Police, by one Tsang Ping (湯斌), residing in the
Dz Oen Li (莊安里),.......(? Ningpo Road).
------------------

I confidentially report to you that more than
ten Fokienese communists have arrived in Shanghai and
are in hiding in the Kyih Sung (奇陞) Lodging House,
No.10, Lane 195,Fokien Road. The leaders are
named Toong Tsong Yuan (董宗元), Li (李), Zau
(趙) and they speak the northern dialect. They
come to Shanghai for the purpose of secretly organizing
subversive activities. Please send detectives
to investigate and effect their arrest so as to
remove the evil from the Settlement.

(Signed) Citizen: Tsang Ping.

18th.
pages.zh:
1934年1月18日致上海公共租界工部局警务处转交督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）的匿名信译文，写信人为居住在莊安里（Dz Oen Li）.......(? 宁波路) 的汤斌（Tsang Ping）。
------------------

本人向阁下密报，十余名福建籍共产党人已抵达上海，并藏匿于福建路195弄10号奇陞（Kyih Sung）客栈。其头目名为董宗元（Toong Tsong Yuan）、李氏（Li）、赵氏（Zau），他们讲北方方言。他们来上海的目的是秘密组织颠覆活动。请派遣侦探进行调查并将其逮捕，以清除租界内的祸害。

（签名）公民：汤斌。

18日。
